ambiguities_or_notes: Every source block (27) has a matching target block, with page markers, numbering, quotation structure, and italics preserved.

Website Circle of Reading paragraphs served as the first draft; each was re-read against the Russian and revised where it drifted (omissions, additions, generic he/his, terminology, attribution form).

«Закон божий» (zakon bozhiy) and «закон бога» (zakon boga) are both 'the law of God'; «закон божеский» (zakon bozheskiy) is 'the divine law'. «Иосиф Мадзини» (Iosif Madzini) is Giuseppe Mazzini; «Мартино» (Martino) is Martineau.

Source observation: [18] «п *рименяя» (p rimenyaya) is a split word, «применяя» (primenyaya, 'applying'), with the italics broken around its first letter; translated in that sense and italicized as a whole
